# Frozen numerical regression baseline

Generated before retiring the legacy solver on 2026-09-24, using the small cases in test_solver.py.
Nine schemes, fixed/prescribed steps; two SAV adaptive cases. Captures states, diagnostics, times and counters.
The baseline checks migration consistency, not mathematical correctness. Analytic Fourier-mode and driver tests remain independent.
